## Context / Problem

Current-base archaeology shows that `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py:414-418` registers `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review`, but no bare `review` command. Both `docs/exit-codes.md:184` and `AGENTS.md:239-240` still claim that bare `review` is a deprecated forwarding shim. Those maintained pages misstate the current CLI contract.

## Approach

Delete the stale bare-`review` entry from `docs/exit-codes.md` and rewrite the stale AGENTS LLM-operations guidance to describe only `review-plan`, `review-code`, and the relevant current migration/compatibility state. Retain the accurate `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review` rows unchanged except for immediately necessary table formatting. Do not add a command-reference generator and do not change the CLI registry: source inspection is the verification boundary, not an implementation target.

## Scope

- `docs/exit-codes.md` — remove the stale deprecated `review` shim row.
- `AGENTS.md` — remove or rewrite the stale claim that bare `review` forwards to `review-plan`.
- Read-only verification: `src/rebar/_cli/_registry.py` establishes the live command set.

## Testing

Run the existing documentation checks. Confirm the registry has no bare `review` route and run an anchored maintained-guidance search, `rg -n 'rebar review($|[^-])' AGENTS.md README.md docs`, so `review-plan` and `review-code` cannot create false positives. Separately search for the deprecated-forwarding wording in the two edited pages.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Neither `docs/exit-codes.md` nor `AGENTS.md` presents bare `review` as an available or forwarding CLI command.
- [ ] The documented `review-code`, `review-plan`, and `sign-review` exit-code rows remain accurate and present.
- [ ] Anchored maintained-guidance search finds no bare `rebar review` invocation; `rebar review-plan` and `rebar review-code` are not false positives.
- [ ] Existing documentation checks pass without expanding command-reference generation ownership.
